name: Exp_ColorXPWMA_Digit_MMRec
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorXPWMA_Digit indicator, which is a colored weighted moving average with digital signal processing. It incorporates money management with a recovery mechanism, likely increasing position size after losses to recover equity.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorXPWMA_Digit指标进行交易，该指标是一种带数字信号处理的彩色加权移动平均线。它集成了带有回恢复制的资金管理，可能在亏损后增加仓位以恢复权益。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ColorXPWMA_Digit指标的趋势方向变化，当指标颜色从一种切换到另一种时产生交易信号。入场条件为指标颜色切换且确认趋势方向改变，多头入场在指标由跌转涨时，空头入场在指标由涨转跌时。出场条件包括反向信号出现时平仓或止损/止盈触发。仓位管理采用资金管理模块，根据账户余额和风险比例计算初始手数。资金管理的回恢复制（MMRec）意味着在亏损交易后可能增加下一笔交易的手数，这是一种危险的资金恢复策略。整体策略是典型的趋势跟踪加马丁格尔式回恢复合策略。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend direction changes signaled by the ColorXPWMA_Digit indicator, which applies digital signal processing to a weighted moving average and displays trend direction via color changes. Entry conditions trigger when the indicator color switches, with long entries on bullish color change and short entries on bearish color change. Exit conditions include closing positions on reverse signal or when stop loss/take profit levels are hit. Position sizing uses a money management module that calculates initial lot size based on account balance and risk ratio. The recovery mechanism (MMRec) likely increases lot size after losing trades to recover equity, which is a dangerous martingale-style approach. Overall, this is a trend-following strategy combined with a martingale-style recovery money management system.

parameters.name: LotSize
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size, used when MMRec is disabled

parameters.name: MM_Type
parameters.description: 资金管理类型（恢复模式）

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points (0 = no stop loss)

pros: 使用数字信号处理平滑均线，减少虚假信号
彩色指标直观显示趋势方向，便于理解策略逻辑
内置资金管理模块，可根据账户规模动态调整仓位
pros_en: Uses digital signal processing to smooth the moving average, reducing false signals
Color-coded indicator provides intuitive trend direction display for easy strategy understanding
Built-in money management module dynamically adjusts position size based on account size
cons: 回恢复制类似马丁格尔策略，连续亏损可能导致爆仓
可能缺少止损保护，风险控制不足
单一指标策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁虚假信号
cons_en: Recovery mechanism resembles martingale strategy, consecutive losses could blow the account
May lack stop loss protection, insufficient risk control
Single indicator strategy prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets
improvements: 移除马丁格尔式回恢复制，改用固定比例风险管理
增加止损和额外的趋势确认指标以减少虚假信号
improvements_en: Remove martingale-style recovery mechanism and use fixed fractional risk management instead
Add stop loss and additional trend confirmation indicators to reduce false signals

risk_points: 马丁格尔式回恢复制会在连续亏损时指数级增加仓位，可能导致爆仓
缺少强制止损保护，单笔亏损可能超出可承受范围
risk_points_en: Martingale-style recovery mechanism exponentially increases position size during consecutive losses, potentially leading to account blowup
Lack of mandatory stop loss protection means single trade losses may exceed tolerable limits

summary_en: This EA trades based on the ColorXPWMA_Digit indicator, which is a colored weighted moving average with digital signal processing. It incorporates money management with a recovery mechanism, likely increasing position size after losses to recover equity.
